policy: M01-T01 local CSPRNG policy (test-only, local host only)
authority_rule: Simulated claim authority comes only from the audited in-session issuance path (issueAttemptNonce through node:crypto.randomBytes plus same-session registry presentation). A caller-supplied nonce_source label is not proof of cryptographic origin; no entropy is inferred from a nonce value. Shape admission (validateClaimMetadata) alone grants no simulated claim authority.
rules: Fresh 128-bit random component required for every simulated claim nonce, issued via issueAttemptNonce in-session.
Timestamp, counter, model-generated text, Math.random, predictable, or self-labelled values MUST NOT acquire simulated claim authority (NONCE_ORIGIN_UNPROVEN).
Unavailable/invalid/failed qualified CSPRNG prohibits claim creation and fails closed (BLOCKED); a failed issuance mints no registry entry.
Random output is excluded from deterministic-byte equality assertions; only shape/issuance/policy are asserted deterministically.
weak_fixtures_that_must_fail: self-labelled predictable hex with a qualified label (shape admits value, authority gate rejects)
native_note: Local qualification only. Android/native RNG availability remains BLOCKED until NATIVE_PROCEDURE.md is realized.
